evidence.note: requeuedAfterFailure is assigned true only in the O.some(command) arm of requeueLastProjectionRequest; None+true is never written.

Fresh graphRequestAtom traffic always writes Some(projectGraph|applyGraphDelta) and clears requeuedAfterFailure together; success handlers at 1860 and 1866 clear the marker while retaining that command.

notes: Seed 4/3 treated lastProjectionRequest as presence-only. Live producers only store projectGraph or applyGraphDelta, so Option payload is none|projectGraph|applyGraphDelta times the retry bit: six representable, five legal (absent+retried unreachable). Tagged retry state absent|retryable(command)|retried(command) with those two command payloads.
